title: How is Hitler connected to Verity?
description: Eight real pictures connect Adolf Hitler to Verity, the smiley from the viral Minecraft horror series, through Yugoslavia's regent, George VI, the Queen, Reagan, Arnold, Chris Pratt and YouTuber Rubius.
hook: How is Hitler connected to Verity?
fun_fact: In 1923, a year after their Romanian photo, the future George VI was the best man at Prince Paul's wedding in Belgrade.
research_note: Verity's creator ThatMob has never shown his face, so the chain ends on a YouTuber who played the Verity mod on camera: in Rubius's 2026 video his facecam and Verity share the same frame.

links.line: In 1939, Hitler hosted Yugoslavia's ruler, Prince Paul, in Berlin.

image.file: File:(De droite à gauche) prince Carol de Roumanie, prince Paul de Serbie, duc de Gènes, duc d'York (au couronnement du souverain de Roumanie, le 15 octobre 1922, à Bucarest) - btv1b530960076.jpg

links.line: Back in 1922, Prince Paul joined Britain's future king, George VI, in Romania.

image.file: File:Royal Air Force Bomber Command, 1942-1945. CH20901.jpg

links.line: In the 1940s, George VI met airmen with his daughter, Princess Elizabeth.

image.file: File:Ronald Reagan with Queen Elizabeth II.jpg

links.line: In 1983, Queen Elizabeth toured California as Ronald Reagan's guest.

image.file: File:President Ronald Reagan with Arnold Schwarzenegger Retouched (cropped).jpg

links.line: In 1984, Reagan shook hands with a young Arnold Schwarzenegger in Dallas.
In 2025, Arnold posed at his premiere with his son-in-law, Chris Pratt.

image.credit: elrubiusOMG (YouTube), "RETOS CON JENNIFER LAWRENCE Y CHRIS PRATT"

links.line: Back in 2016, Pratt took on internet challenges with Spanish YouTuber Rubius.

image.credit: Rubius (YouTube), "Instalé el Mod Más TURBIO de Minecraft (Verity)"

links.line: And in 2026, Rubius came face to face with Verity.
